name: Katagiri Asuka
source:
Asuka is a childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c17365]Takuya[/url]. Ever since they were kids, she has always looked out for him. Naturally, she's uneasy about Takuya's [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]new form[/url], but she continues to support him through his ordeal. With her tough facade, it's hard to tell how she really feels about the situation.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582010-x-change/faqs/22272]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
